From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@velotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-29T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Technical handoff & time swap: Redwood deep-technical session

Hi Alex —

Great to speak during discovery yesterday. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive to:
- Walk through your current inference topology and constraints (latency/SLOs, throughput).
- Map our recommended deployment options (hosted vs. dedicated vs. private).
- Validate network/firewall and data path questions with your infra team.

Proposed windows (all PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00–11:15
- Tue Aug 3, 15:00–16:15
- Wed Aug 4, 09:00–10:15

Agenda and a rough network diagram are attached — Marissa (SE) will lead the architecture walk; Ben (AE) will present business/contract milestones toward Dedicated if that’s useful.

Please let me know which of the slots works or propose two alternatives with your preferred timezone. If you want Samir or a network engineer included, add them so we can coordinate ports and peering items ahead of time.

Attachments:
- velotech-prelim-agenda.pdf (agenda + prep checklist)
- velotech-network-topology.png (sketch from discovery)

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Thanks, Rafael —

Appreciate the agenda and diagrams; helpful summary. We definitely want Marissa on the call. Quick scheduling note: both suggested blocks on Aug 3 are during our company-wide release window (we have a freeze) — that makes attending difficult for our infra folks.

Our team can do the following (all PT):
- Thu Aug 5, 09:30–11:00
- Fri Aug 6, 13:00–14:30

Samir (cc) is our infra lead and would like to confirm whether you need any inbound IPs whitelisted ahead of the session (we try to pre-stage those during discovery). Also, can you share the run-of-show for the first 20 minutes? We want to ensure we have the right stakeholders from our side.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-07-29T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Technical handoff & time swap: Redwood deep-technical session

Alex —

Thanks for the heads up. Thu Aug 5 09:30–11:00 PT works for us; penciling that in now. If anything changes we'll update the calendar immediately.

Run-of-show (first ~20 minutes):
1) Introductions & goals (5 min) — clarifying success criteria for the session (Rafael)
2) Current state recap & constraints (10 min) — your infra (Samir) + any telemetry you can share
3) Redwood topology recommendation overview (5 min) — Marissa

After that we’ll deep-dive into network/peering, KV caching behavior, and fallback/routing policies. If you want us to include a short notes doc for the infra checklist (ports, KMS, egress rules), we can attach it prior to the call.

Networking/whitelist: we typically provide a short IP list for test connectivity and a single FQDN for metadata endpoints. For the deep-dive we do not need inbound data plane peering — read-only telemetry/metrics calls are all outbound from your VPC unless you ask for a private connector. Still, if Samir prefers to pre-stage firewall entries we can send a minimal list.

Attachments updated: added a short SLA extract (redwood-sla-extract.docx) and a small checklist.

Can you confirm the attendee list from your side (names + roles)? That helps Marissa tailor the network portion. Once confirmed I’ll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read.

— Rafael
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
